title: GTM workspace lost-reason categories (lost-reasons.json)
description: Written by the Strategy seat and published with workspace/refresh/publish-lost-reasons.mjs. Each entry puts one closed-lost deal in a category; deals not listed are auto-mapped from HubSpot's reason. workspace/src/lost-reasons.js is the enforcing validator (it also rejects duplicate deal ids and files over 2 MiB); this schema mirrors it.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time with seconds and an explicit offset (Z or ±hh:mm).

deal_id.description: The HubSpot deal id, without (or with) the page's "deal-" prefix. Unique within the file.

competitor.description: Optional competitor name; only with category competitor. Absent or null shows as unnamed.

competitors.description: Optional. Names the fallback rules recognize in HubSpot's reason for deals not listed in deals.
